description: Rejects the Finite-to-Matrix Promotion Fallacy where checking a small row-count table or a single column is asserted to prove non-existence of a fourth MUB without evaluating all 36 vector unbiasing constraints.
negative_fixture: The 4-element row-count table for F_6 has no compatible row, proving MUB(6)=3.
positive_fixture: Evaluating exact Jaming (2009) bound and Tao Eisenstein norm N(3) = 9 != 0 excludes fourth MUB extension.
